notes: Phobos Exchange story pack (0.2.0 draft): one place-less thread for the exchange and one per listed company, so ChatGPT and add-ons have somewhere to put news, adverts, small talk and the event arcs the exchange starts. Content to come from the handoff in docs/development/exchange-stories-handoff.md.
